risks.risk: Battery may not actually be 72V/20Ah or may be degraded (lead-acid capacity loss), affecting range and performance.
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of the battery label/spec (voltage, Ah, chemistry) and a photo of the battery connections/pack.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst case: lead-acid battery with unknown/possibly reduced capacity (assume lower range/performance).

risks.risk: Whether it truly 'runs' and how well (throttle response, motor noise, controller faults) is not testable from the single photo.
risks.proof: Short video clip starting from cold: power on, throttle test, and a brief ride or wheel spin test showing it accelerates.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven to run properly (assume basic functionality only).

risks.risk: Tires/brakes may be worn or faulty; photo resolution doesn’t confirm tread depth or brake condition.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of front and rear tires (tread) and both brake areas (disc/drum and pads/shoes).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as needing possible service/parts due to unknown wear.

risks.risk: Charger compatibility and charging port condition (loose port, wrong charger voltage) could cause no-charge or battery damage.
risks.proof: Photo of the charger label (output voltage/current) and close-up of the charging port; show charging indicator if available.
risks.if_unproven: Priced assuming charger/charging setup may need replacement or repair.

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the battery label/spec confirming 72V and 20Ah and that it is lead-acid (plus photos of the battery pack).
Video: power on + throttle test + brief ride/wheel movement showing it accelerates and stops reliably.
Close-ups: front/rear tires tread, brake area(s), and charging port.
Photo of the charger label (output specs) and confirmation it charges the bike.
response.reason: The item type is visible, but the key pricing drivers (exact battery specs/health and confirmed running condition) are not verifiable from the single photo. Without battery label and a running test, a worst-case price would be too speculative.
